integrity: An explicit full canonical-differential basis and an exact finite-field matrix certificate are supplied. Reproduce with the standard-library checker and compare the embedded certificate. Source maximality and automorphism-lift facts are cited, not claimed anew.
scientific_limitations: The exact semigroup is proved only at the 48 rational branch places of the stated genus-17 curve, not at its other places; neither generic maximal curves nor AG-code minimum distances are classified. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Weierstrass semigroup at the 48 branch places of a genus-17 maximal curve
